user.title: OeMAG Marktpreis
user.description: The market price is scraped from oem-ag.at. Pick the sensor that counts the energy you feed into the grid - the compensation is calculated from it and written as a statistic you can select in the Energy Dashboard.

data_description.energy_entity: A total_increasing energy sensor. Wh and kWh both work.
data_description.technology: OeMAG publishes a separate price for wind.

abort.single_instance_allowed: OeMAG Marktpreis is already set up.

rebuild_statistics.name: Rebuild compensation
rebuild_statistics.description: Recalculates the whole compensation history from the first recorded hour. Needed after OeMAG corrects an already published price, or to backfill once. Regular updates only touch the last two months.

set_price.name: Set price
set_price.description: Records a market price by hand and recalculates the compensation with it. Use it when the page leaves a gap - typically December, whose price is published in January, by which time the page may already show the new year's table.

month.name: Month
month.description: The month the price is for, as YYYY-MM.

price.name: Price
price.description: In ct/kWh, exactly as the page states it.

clear_price.name: Remove price
clear_price.description: Removes a price that was entered by hand and recalculates. Published prices are not affected.

month.name: Month
month.description: The month to remove, as YYYY-MM.
